name: Type a short literal string
impact: Types text into whatever input field is focused. Harmless on your own device.
notes: Demonstrates the keyboard report path (Report ID 1). Change the string to anything you like.
source: HID Usage Page 0x07 (Keyboard/Keypad). See USB HID Usage Tables 1.12.
action: type Hello from the Bluetooth HID keyboard lab

name: Home key (Consumer Control)
impact: Sends the consumer 'Home' usage. Android returns to the launcher.
notes: Uses Report ID 2 (Consumer Control). Whether the OS acts on it is up to the OS.

name: Media play/pause
impact: Toggles media playback on the target.

name: Next track
impact: Skips to the next media item.
source: HID Usage Page 0x0C, usage 0x00B5 (Scan Next Track).

name: Open the local demo page
impact: Focuses the browser address bar and navigates to a page you serve locally.
notes: Serve examples/demo_page first: python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory examples/demo_page. Nothing is fetched from the internet.
source: Browser convention (Ctrl+L focuses the address bar) + Report ID 1 typing.

name: New browser tab
impact: Opens a new tab in the focused browser.
notes: Works on desktop browsers. Some platforms use a different shortcut.

name: Select all text
impact: Selects all text in the focused field or document.

name: Open the desktop terminal (Linux)
impact: Opens a terminal on many Linux desktops. Only run this on a machine you own.
notes: Shortcut depends on the desktop environment; not all have one.
